title: Arabic Fixer for Bedrock
description: Fixes Arabic text display between Bedrock & Java players with proper customizable chat formatting
body:
**ArabicFix - The Ultimate Arabic Text Solution for Minecraft Bedrock & Java Crossplay :**
ArabicFix reshapes and reverses Arabic text so it reads correctly across both Bedrock and Java players, in chat. It solves the common problem of Arabic letters appearing disconnected or in the wrong reading order on cross-platform servers.

It supports LuckPerms prefixes and DiscordSRV chat relay, so formatted text stays readable wherever it's displayed.

**What the plugin do exactly:**
- Turn this "ﻚﻟﺎﺣ ﻒﻴﻛ ﻢﻜﻴﻠﻋ مﻼﺴﻟﺍ" in to this "السلام عليكم كيف حالك".
  ![what exactly the plugin do :](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/22aa8ada6531fe1429d3cff8ed0d3b936b854a5e_0.webp)

 **Key Features:**
- Fixes Arabic text display between Bedrock & Java editions
- Customizable chat formatting with LuckPerms prefix support
- Advanced Arabic character processing (proper letter shaping & Harakat support)
- Lightweight & efficient - No performance impact on your server
- Integrated DiscordSRV support

 **Perfect For:**
- Arabic Minecraft communities
- Servers with Bedrock-Java crossplay

Tested MC Versions: [1.21 - 26.2].

**Chat Format Configuration Options:**
  
```
# Chat format configuration
# Available placeholders:
# <prefix> - Player prefix (from LuckPerms or default)
# <player> - Player display name
# <message> - The chat message
chat-format: "<prefix><player> &8→ &f<message>"
```
